blocks.text:
This trip through Peru takes you from the Pacific coast into the Andes and back again. Start in Lima by the ocean, then head up to Cusco and Machu Picchu. Travel through the Sacred Valley and the Andes to Lake Titicaca before descending to Colca Canyon and Arequipa, the White City. Once back in Lima, you can add Paracas and a flight over the Nazca Lines. Finish in Tumbes with full board and time to relax on the Pacific coast.

## What you’ll see

In Lima, visit Miraflores and the historic centre, including Lima Cathedral, the Convent of Santo Domingo and the historic Casa Aliaga. In the evening, visit a fountain complex.

In Cusco, explore Sacsayhuamán, Coricancha, Tambomachay and Puka Pukara. Cusco is also your starting point for Machu Picchu and a tour of the Sacred Valley that takes in Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Chinchero, Moray and the Awanakancha centre.

The journey from Cusco to Puno is an excursion in its own right, with stops in Andahuaylillas, Raqchi, Sicuani, La Raya and Pucará. You can take the Titicaca Train instead of the bus.

Next come Lake Titicaca and the floating Uros Islands, followed by Colca Canyon, its condors and Arequipa. The pace slows after you return to Lima, with optional visits to Paracas and Nazca before you fly to Tumbes for a few days on the coast.
